description: Na₆MgV₂(SO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two S and four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.94 Å) and one longer (3.05 Å) Na-S bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.93 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one S and three O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 3.05 Å. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and one longer (2.35 Å) Na-O bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one S and three O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 2.95 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.46 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one S and four O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 2.80 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.90 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.54 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two S and two O atoms. There is one shorter (2.73 Å) and one longer (3.29 Å) Na-S bond length. There is one shorter (2.22 Å) and one longer (2.29 Å) Na-O bond length. Mg is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two S and three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.48 Å) and one longer (2.81 Å) Mg-S bond length. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one S and three O atoms. The V-S bond length is 2.36 Å. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.86 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one S and three O atoms. The V-S bond length is 2.38 Å. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.89 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one V atom. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₄V trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃V tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄V trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃V tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄V trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₄V trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃V tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄V trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄V trigonal bipyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃V tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one V atom.
